```python
# filename: crosscheck_tabular_extraction.py
import pandas as pd
import tabula

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/67e8878b-5cef-4375-804e-e6291fdbe78a.pdf"

# Extract tables
tables = tabula.read_pdf(pdf_path, pages='all', multiple_tables=True)
df = pd.concat(tables, ignore_index=True)

# Identify section header rows and propagate type
types = []
current_type = None
section_labels = {"Hotels", "Motels", "Villas", "Guesthouses", "Inns", "Resorts", "Cottages", "B&Bs"}

for _, row in df.iterrows():
    name = str(row.get('Name', '')).strip()
    if name in section_labels:
        current_type = name
        types.append(None)
    else:
        types.append(current_type)

df['Type'] = types

clean = df[(df['Type'].notnull()) & (df['Rating (out of 5)'].notnull())]
summary = clean.groupby('Type').agg(count=('Name','count'), avg=('Rating (out of 5)','mean')).reset_index()
print(summary)

best_idx = summary['avg'].idxmax()
print(f"\nBest type: {summary.loc[best_idx, 'Type']} ({summary.loc[best_idx, 'avg']:.2f})")
```
